semantics.state_update: At each posedge clk, capture majority(a,b,state): 00 clears, 11 sets, unequal a/b hold previous state. Sample before coincident input changes.
semantics.q: Combinational a XOR b XOR state
semantics.reset: None in original interface; no reset added.
semantics.initialization: state uninitialized X, matching 0ns,5ns,10ns. First known capture at 15ns.
semantics.evidence: 55ns and 65ns hold 0 across unequal prior inputs; 125ns and 135ns hold 1 across unequal prior inputs; 75ns sets after 11, 145ns clears after 00.

numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise AND and XOR; no numeric overflow or rounding

verification.oracle: Original waveform literal expected state/q at each 5ns timestamp through 190ns; supplementary binary truth-table checks and capture/hold tests
verification.sampling: Raise clock at original timestamp, let sequential sampling complete, then apply coincident changed inputs within same timestamp and check after settling.
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation timeout; fatal on mismatch; explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities: Finite waveform cannot uniquely determine arbitrary circuits; majority next-state and parity q fit all observed rows and both hold states.

Coincident input/clock rows do not specify delta ordering explicitly; state at 45ns,75ns,85ns requires capture of preceding inputs, so replay changes after sequential sampling within the same timestamp.
